nodes.label: Hikaru Style-Prior Move Ranker
nodes.rationale: Lightweight, non-engine heuristic ranker predicting moves based on historical style priors (piece type, square, check/capture flags) combined with exact-position matching.

nodes.label: SQLite WAL Mode for Puzzle DB Creation
nodes.rationale: Configures SQLite with journal_mode=WAL and synchronous=NORMAL to optimize transaction performance when parsing and inserting millions of Lichess CSV records.
nodes.norm_label: sqlite wal mode for puzzle db creation

nodes.label: Wrangler D1 SQL Chunking Strategy
nodes.rationale: Chunks the puzzle SQLite database into 10,000-row SQL insert scripts to stay under Cloudflare D1's payload limit (approx 25MB) and prevent SQLite_TOOBIG errors.
